name: Sofar PowerAll
tagline: Single-phase all-in-one inverter and battery, 5 kWh to 30 kWh.
summary: The Sofar PowerAll combines a single-phase hybrid inverter with one to six 5.12 kWh LFP battery modules in a modular stack.
Capacity can be expanded later, and the system switches to critical loads in under 10 milliseconds. It is rated IP65.

highlights.title: Modular design
highlights.text: The integrated modular build makes transport and installation simple.

highlights.title: Expandable capacity
highlights.text: Add battery modules as your energy needs grow.

highlights.title: Low standby use
highlights.text: The battery uses very little power in sleep mode.

highlights.title: Fast switchover
highlights.text: Switches to critical loads in under 10 milliseconds.

highlights.title: High-current panels
highlights.text: Compatible with high current PV panels, with two MPPTs.

highlights.title: Display and app
highlights.text: LCD display plus app and Bluetooth, with WiFi communication.
